args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since its latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Incident opened to track follow-up on root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident** — Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, error rate back down to 0.2%.

The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
